#include <iostream>
#include <gmpxx.h>

int main() {
    mpz_class MOD("998244353");
    long n, m, L, R;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    long k = R - L + 1;

    if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
        mpz_class base = k;
        mpz_class exponent = n * m;
        mpz_class result;
        mpz_powm(result.get_mpz_t(), base.get_mpz_t(), exponent.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    } else {
        long eCount = R / 2 - (L - 1) / 2;
        long oCount = k - eCount;
        mpz_class E(eCount);
        mpz_class O(oCount);
        mpz_class exp(n * m);
        mpz_class sum, diff, numerator, denominator, result;

        // sum = (E + O)^exp mod MOD
        mpz_class sum_base = E + O;
        mpz_powm(sum.get_mpz_t(), sum_base.get_mpz_t(), exp.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());

        // diff = (E - O)^exp mod MOD
        mpz_class diff_base = E - O;
        mpz_powm(diff.get_mpz_t(), diff_base.get_mpz_t(), exp.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());

        // result = ((sum + diff) * (1 + MOD) / 2) mod MOD
        mpz_class numerator = sum + diff;
        mpz_class denominator = 2;
        mpz_class inv_two;
        mpz_invert(inv_two.get_mpz_t(), denominator.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t()); // modular inverse of 2
        result = (numerator * inv_two) % MOD;

        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
